messages:
acme_ops: Hey team—we just got our monthly invoice and billed tokens are ~3x what the dashboard shows for the same date range. samples attached: request ids r-8f3a, r-8f3b. Can someone explain?

support_jade: Sorry about that. Can you paste the request payloads or the endpoint you used? quick question: were these streaming or non-streaming calls? :thinking:

acme_ops: Mostly streaming (chunked) completions and some embedding calls. We use continuous batching on our side (one TCP connection, many short prompts).

support_jade: Got it. Re-assigning to billing for initial triage. pls hold on.

billing_omar: Looking up the request ids now. I see the invoice shows tokens charged at 2.9M for 2026-02-08 while dashboard shows ~1.0M served tokens. The entries flagged have a note: `prefetch-prefilled` in the metering log.

billing_omar: Could be related to prefetch / warmup in the continuous batcher — sometimes prefetch work is metered as served if it runs in a GPU host that later gets used. Need eng help to interpret. @eng_runtime_lee can you take?

eng_runtime_lee: On it. Quick explainer: our continuous batcher does prefix prefetch (KV cache warmup) when similar session signatures appear. We currently account prefetch work as billable when it executes on a dedicated serving host because it consumes CPU/GPU cycles. However it should be marked separately in telemetry as `prefetch` and not double-count GPU token service if the realtime request reuses the cached KV. Sounds like invoice aggregation may have included both prefetch and the later served tokens without dedup.

acme_ops: So we were billed for the prefetch + the served tokens? That would explain the delta. Is there a way to prevent double-charge?

eng_runtime_lee: Two things to check: 1) whether your client is sending short prefixes that trigger repeated prefetches (many unique prefixes => more prefetch), 2) whether continuous-batching was configured with `allow_warmup=true` on your Dedicated pool. If both true, you'll see extra billed work.

eng_ml_sara: Also note streaming clients that send lots of tiny prompts can cause repeated KV cache lookups that look like unique contexts to the runtime. Small change: normalize prefixes or batch similar prompts server-side to lower prefetch.

acme_ops: Any quick repro steps we can run? We need something to show to our finance team.

eng_runtime_lee: Repro idea: run a short loop of 500 streaming requests with varying prefixes vs 500 identical prefixes. Compare `metering` logs via `GET /internal/telemetry/metering?reqid=<id>` and check fields `type: prefetch` vs `type: served`. Also set env `REDWOOD_PREFETCH_DEBUG=1` on your private deployment to get detailed prefetch traces in the logs.

support_jade: If you want, we can run a lightweight replay using your sample request ids in a controlled environment to confirm. Would you like us to do that?

acme_ops: yes please — that would be super helpful. forwarding sample payloads now.

cs_rebecca: Escalating to billing + eng for expedited checking. I linked the customer's invoice: https://invoices.redwood.ai/acc/ACME/2026-02 .

invoices-bot: Snapshot saved: invoice-ACME-2026-02 (hash: a3f5). Billing team note added.

billing_omar: Thanks. We'll hold off adjustments until eng confirms double-count. If confirmed, we can apply a one-off credit and adjust metering to split prefetch vs served in the next invoice cycle.

eng_runtime_lee: One more nuance: if prefetch runs on a different host than the eventual serve host, we currently can’t dedupe across hosts (KV prefetch is non-authoritative until the serve host pulls it). We are tracking a pending runtime patch that tags prefetch tokens as `prefetch_only` in billing exports to prevent this. ETA: next monthly deploy.

eng_ml_sara: Workaround for now: disable prefetch on your Dedicated pool or set `max_prefix_variants=1` in the batcher config to reduce warmup churn. Both will lower billed prefetch tokens.

acme_ops: Ok we'll try disabling prefetch on our Dedicated and send results. Appreciate the fast triage. :+1:

support_jade: Thanks all — I'll create a support ticket note with the proposed credit path and link to this thread. Ticket #SUP-2026-1123.

billing_omar: Follow-up action: once eng confirms, we'll provision a credit and update the invoice.

eng_runtime_lee: Filed internal issue INF-9832 to ensure prefetch tokens are exported separately and not aggregated into served totals.

acme_ops: update: we disabled prefetch and re-ran 1000 requests — dashboard vs metered now aligns within 2%. Sending logs in the ticket.

support_jade: Perfect — closing loop after billing posts the credit. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
